verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents its own asynchronous Video API for headless video generation. You submit a job, poll or receive a webhook when it completes, and download the finished .mp4 from a time-limited link, so unattended automation pipelines are possible without the UI. However, nothing in the evidence covers CI use specifically, such as a CLI, CI recipes, or service-account and token guidance. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, headless auth/rate-limit guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of automated pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Asynchronous — you submit a job and poll or get a webhook when it's ready.
Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
rather than polling Synthesia API, it is possible to configure a webhook to which Synthesia sends a notification when a video completes successfully.
the response includes then a time-limited download link in the `download` attribute, use this link to download the video as an `.mp4`
